description: This file defines a React functional component for taking quizzes within an LMS web application. It manages quiz loading, question navigation, answer submission, timer, and result display.

methods.name: TakeQuiz()
methods.description: Main React component handling quiz interaction, including loading quizzes, selecting questions, answering, timing, submitting, and reviewing results.

methods.name: load()
methods.description: Loads the list of available quizzes from the database using Supabase client.

methods.name: loadQuiz
methods.description: Loads a selected quiz and its questions, initiates timer if relevant.

methods.name: setAnswer
methods.description: Records user's answer for a specific question.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that all questions have answers before submission.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Submits the quiz answers, computes score, and displays results.

methods.name: renderQuestion
methods.description: Renders individual question UI based on question type.
